The original renderer and WebGL helpers were recovered from
`mysite-alternatives/src/uncover-opus/` in `laptop-backup-2026-11-10.zip`,
Claude/Opus’s original browser jelly implementation.

The profile version of `jelly.js` now samples the elastic control grid with a
cubic B-spline, computes thickness from its deformation gradient, softens folded
edges, and adds layered wet highlights and suspended bubbles. Large movements
use increased damping, opening repair waits for settling, and reset eases the
rest positions home. The original mass-over-area sheet and capture API remain.
`gl.js` is unchanged. The recovered comparison copies remain unchanged.
